To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the covariance structure of a stationary random field on a regular lattice is characterized by the Toeplitz-like property, (2) the spectral density of a stationary random fields is consistent and strongly consistent, and (3) the spectral density estimate is asymptotically normal and independent across frequencies.

the spectral density function of a stationary random field on a lattice may be consistently estimated by a truncated autoregressive representation of the field and that the asymptotic distribution is normal and independent at distinct fixed frequencies, as for stationary time series.

autoregressive spectral density estimates of stationary random fields are strongly consistent and asymptotically normal, and that the covariance matrix of stationary random fields on regular lattices has a generalized Toeplitz property.
